summary: Lists pods for an Operator upgrade from a 2.4 redundant controller and hub deployment (with mesh ingress and external database) to the 2.6 enterprise topology, which adds EDA, platform gateway, hub Redis and external Redis and object storage.
questions: What is needed to upgrade redundant controller and hub from 2.4 to 2.6 on OpenShift?
Does automation hub need object storage in the 2.6 enterprise topology?
Which pods are added in the 2.6 Operator enterprise topology?
